Method of Attack: disk-wiping malware deleting files on infected systems
wiping master boot record (MBR) to render computer unbootable
using a new wiper called Filerase to delete data on infected machines
Impacted Systems: oil and gas companies in the Middle East
infected systems targeted by Shamoon malware
Indicators of Compromise: sample uploaded from France to VirusTotal
signed with a digital certificate from Baidu issued March 25, 2015, expired March 26, 2016
image resource depicting burning US Dollar called 'Grant'
previous versions contained images of burning American flag and Syrian refugee child
Attack Vector: disguised as system optimization tool from Baidu
packed using Enigma Protector v4 and UPX packers
likely targeted attacks during western holidays
